claim: Onboarding OB-6, code box (founder /goal 2026-11-07, every fork the session's call; proposal p4-scratch/sw-walk/onboarding/proposal.md §3 OB-6, §4 F3). /verify-email shows a six-digit code box (inputMode numeric, autoComplete one-time-code) to a signed-in, unverified person with no token; a signed-out person sees none. Six digits typed or pasted (spaces and dashes stripped) post { code } once, nothing under six is posted, the box is disabled while posting, and a refusal is worded from its status and code (codeRefusal: CODE_REFUSED or a bare 400 is 'wrong or expired', CODE_SPENT is 'too many tries' with the resend button, CODE_LOCKED_FOR_THE_DAY has its own sentence), never the server's prose. A right code finishes like the link: signInWithSession, then the router. Behavioural proof: apps/web/src/pages/__tests__/VerifyEmail.code.test.tsx, which fails against origin/fix/onboarding-verify-link-runs-in-app's VerifyEmail.tsx and verificationMail.ts.
verify: grep -qF 'inputMode="numeric"' apps/web/src/pages/VerifyEmail.tsx && grep -qF 'autoComplete="one-time-code"' apps/web/src/pages/VerifyEmail.tsx && grep -qF 'code: digits,' apps/web/src/pages/VerifyEmail.tsx && grep -qF 'if (digits.length !== 6 || codeInFlight.current) return' apps/web/src/pages/VerifyEmail.tsx && grep -qF 'setCodeRefused(codeRefusal(err))' apps/web/src/pages/VerifyEmail.tsx && grep -qF "if (code === 'CODE_SPENT') return 'spent'" apps/web/src/lib/verificationMail.ts && test -f apps/web/src/pages/__tests__/VerifyEmail.code.test.tsx
